title: MCGun
description: Add Some Fun About Guns!You Can Craft Them!
body:
##  Overview
This Minecraft mod adds a complete **gun combat system**, new items, custom blocks, a unique dimension, new villager professions, natural structure generation, and custom advancements. It brings brand new tactical shooting gameplay, automatic firing mechanics, exclusive ores, dimension portals, and rare world generation content for survival and adventure.
## What This Mod Adds
**Fire Gun**
![A Fire Gun.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/879b6b80794f59e745f24ac39d6711a353334ab9.png)

**Normal Gun**
![A Normal Gun.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/207d399944e67bb4c3061483e78b43182670546f.png)

**AWM Gun**
![A AWM Gun.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b53bd29b844feb296cda82d293abf146cc24f6e0.png)

![A Creative Gun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f5eb0059e7108c82a641c97f855722cc9fb0528.png)

This mod also adds matching ammunition items:

![A Fire Bullet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f92b5c572990b10970548fe4d8992f1e202a5b1.png)

![A Awm Bullet.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f35e94bacfb92862f4a3233ad1684ce10163f583.png)

The mod includes a **custom villager profession**:

**SellGunAndBullets Villager**

Use the **GunUseBlock**![A Gun Use Block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9300968cf3dac5ddfc7f82730edffaef50e8000e.png) to assign this profession to villagers.

It also generates natural world content:

Custom **Gun Ruins** structure

A brand new dimension: **Gun Core Verse**, filled with generated structures

Added custom blocks:

**Gun Core Block**
![A Gun Core Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fd22ba9068220a12ba81a5bce9442bf9d5b03a4.png)

**Gun Core Ore**
![A Gun Core Ore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00ef66feeed0d9a1983b690df1c9f07ebfec429e.png)

![A Gun Animal Soul Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/654fd5030bacbc3292ff797e55c757df8a500a54.png)

Two custom advancements are added:

**GotTheGunCore**

**GoToTheGunCoreVerse**

This mod adds an armor name **Core Armer**

It can protect you to kill Boss.

This mod adds humanoid mobs name Gun Animal that spawn only in the Gun Core Verse.![A Gun Core Animal Spawn Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/307273697e709475e38a85dd18726dbe5ea5fd6e.png)

They wear armor and carry rare items, and they attack with Normal Gun.

These mobs can be tamed and ridden by players, and they will battle each other on 
their own.

They also explode when defeated, dropping **Gun Animal Soul**![A Gun Animal Soul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a343e2565b09fd794fff42355d959f8c0e8d46a0.png).

This mod adds a BOSS that just spawn in Gun Boss Spawn Egg.![A Gun Boss Spawn Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98fd52a17e0d3269fb59fa2bad453b7c8260e576.png)

## How to Use Guns
If you own a gun and matching bullets, **right-click to shoot**.

For the Normal Gun, Fire Gun and Creative Gun, **hold right-click** to activate full auto 
continuous firing.
## How to Access the Gun Core Verse
Build a portal frame just like a Nether Portal, using Gun Core Blocks.
![I Build A Portal With Gun Core Block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90ba9f42cd4d27728c0b2b61e0d197a457c4aa9a.png)

Use the Portal Igniter to activate the portal.
![I Use Gun Portal Portal Igniter Make Portal Open.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80be256ea98d52139e4bdf87055a6942feaeb0d6.png)

Walk into the portal to travel.
![I Go Into The Portal.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d588285675e72def7e6ad59b6f83f73f6be7995.png)

You will arrive at the Gun Core Verse dimension.
![I Am At The Gun Core Verse.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9805e95d977795131a54a7380a4b9772cba57a1.png)

## How to Find Gun Core Ore
Mine down to the depth of **Y = -63 ~ -64**.
![I Go Deep At Y = -63](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b2e39d90a7050d7f218a76cb9b922e32b60f39b.png)

Explore this layer carefully. **Only one Gun Core Ore generates per chunk**.
![It Is Difficult To Find Gun Core Ore,I Didn't Find One Now.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e00f4148558a53539dbfa1dacf73eeca1a0bda0.png)

Use a **Diamond Pickaxe** to mine Gun Core Ore once found.
![Find It And I Must Use Diamond Pickaxe To Mining It.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b5c884e6b05d18b5c2e21716fe74cee31073bac.png)

**You can also find something that I didn't tell!**
